input_oneliner: 46M IVDU w/ PICC for vertebral osteo, day 10 vanc, T 38.9 with rigors tonight, no localizing sx per RN

optional_context.comorbidity: injection drug use, vertebral osteomyelitis, PICC line

reference_targets_freetext.item: Inspect and palpate the PICC insertion site and tract for erythema, tenderness, purulence, and a palpable cord along the vein
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Exit-site findings are specific but insensitive for line infection

reference_targets_freetext.item: Cardiac auscultation for a new or changed murmur
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: A new regurgitant murmur is a major Duke criterion in a high-pretest IVDU population

reference_targets_freetext.item: Peripheral stigmata of endocarditis: splinter hemorrhages, Janeway lesions, Osler nodes, conjunctival petechiae
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Minor Duke criteria; insensitive but specific when present

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about stool frequency and consistency
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Antibiotic exposure makes C. difficile a leading nosocomial cause of fever

reference_targets_freetext.item: Abdominal exam for distension and tenderness
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Abdominal findings with diarrhea signal severe or fulminant colitis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask: timing of rigors relative to infusions or line access, and any injection since admission
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Infusion-related rigors point to the line; in-hospital injection raises new bacteremia risk

reference_targets_freetext.item: Skin exam for a new maculopapular rash
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Vancomycin-associated drug fever and DRESS present with rash

reference_targets_freetext.item: Spinal percussion tenderness and leg neurologic exam (epidural abscess screen)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Progression of vertebral osteomyelitis to epidural abscess can present as recurrent fever

off_bedside_acceptable: MRI spine if new neurologic signs
should_not_recommend: Echocardiogram ordered before cardiac auscultation and line-site inspection
Empiric antibiotic change before examining the line site and obtaining paired cultures
